tools.name: search_manufacturers
tools.description: Find Australian manufacturers by ANZSIC category and state. `export_ready` is accepted for forward compatibility but does not filter results until verified export-readiness data exists.

tools.name: get_manufacturer_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a non-contact company profile using an Australian Business Number. Phone, email and street address are available through the paid get_contact_details tool.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List ANZSIC manufacturing categories and the number of companies in each.

tools.name: get_contact_details
tools.description: Paid Business-plan tool. Provide an active Australian Manufacturing Directory Business API key to retrieve phone, email and street address. Subscribe at https://ausmanufacturingdirectory.com/membership.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_manufacturer_profile, get_contact_details · Private data: get_manufacturer_profile, get_contact_details · Public sink: search_manufacturers, get_manufacturer_profile, get_contact_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_manufacturer_profile, get_contact_details · Private data: get_manufacturer_profile, get_contact_details · Public sink: search_manufacturers, get_manufacturer_profile, get_contact_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
